threat_event: Attacker uses the DCS integrator's remote access tool to reach the engineering workstation and change setpoints and alarm limits on the aqueous ammonia process
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist group targeting OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote desktop tool on the EWS; one shared integrator account; no MFA, session approval, or logging (gap 3)
existing_controls: IT/OT firewall; independent SIS trips on high level and high pressure
treatment_plan: Remove the remote desktop tool; remote access gateway in an OT DMZ with named integrator accounts, MFA, per-session approval by the Shift Supervisor, and session recording

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the business network into the historian and HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Historian dual-homed on business and control networks; "any" firewall rules; no EDR on OT workstations (gaps 2, 7)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-13 OT workstations; BP-01
existing_controls: IT/OT firewall; EDR on office endpoints
treatment_plan: Build an OT DMZ with a historian replica; remove the second network card; rewrite firewall rules to deny by default; OT-approved endpoint protection on HMIs

threat_event: Phishing steals an office user's credentials and gives an attacker a foothold on the business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff click rates unknown; no phishing exercises
existing_controls: MFA on SaaS; EDR on office endpoints; annual office training
treatment_plan: Quarterly phishing exercises; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators

threat_event: Insider uses a shared operator or engineering account to alter recipes or setpoints without attribution
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared HMI and DCS engineering accounts; no DCS audit review (gaps 4, 7)
existing_controls: Badge-controlled control room; background checks at hire
treatment_plan: Unique DCS accounts for every operator and engineer; monthly DCS audit log review; sanctions in POL-01

threat_event: Erroneous recipe change released without a second approval causes an incompatible chemical addition (for example hypochlorite with acid)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recipe and DCS changes outside MOC; no second approval (gap 5)
existing_controls: Written MOC for chemistry and equipment; experienced operators
treatment_plan: Bring DCS, SIS, PLC, and recipe changes into MOC; two-person approval in the batch management system; change log

threat_event: DCS configuration and recipes are destroyed and cannot be restored after ransomware or a server failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups only on the EWS and one USB drive; never restore-tested; no offline copy (gap 8)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (continuity and disaster recovery plans)
existing_controls: Nightly configuration export; spare DCS hardware on site
treatment_plan: Weekly offline and immutable copies; quarterly restore test on spare hardware; SIS program copy verified after each proof test

threat_event: SIS logic is altered or bypassed from the DCS engineering workstation
threat_source: Advanced attacker with OT knowledge; insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SIS keyswitch left in remote program position; SIS engineering software on the DCS EWS (gap 15, found in P07)
existing_controls: Independent logic solver; yearly proof tests
treatment_plan: Keyswitch returned to run and locked (done 2026-08-12); remove SIS software from the EWS; dedicated SIS laptop kept locked; keyswitch position checked each shift

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in an unpatched OT workstation or DCS server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patches only at annual turnaround; DCS two releases behind; no KEV monitoring (gap 6)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (integrate cybersecurity into the system lifecycle)
treatment_plan: Monthly review of DCS vendor advisories and the KEV catalog; quarterly vendor-qualified patching; compensating controls where patches wait for turnaround

threat_event: Malware enters an HMI on a USB drive used for recipe files or vendor updates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Uncontrolled removable media on HMIs (gap 10)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (restrict physical access to critical cyber assets and media)
treatment_plan: Media scanning station at the control room door; block unapproved USB storage on HMIs; approved company-owned drives only

threat_event: Attacker performs reconnaissance and stages tools in the OT network for weeks without being detected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network monitoring; DCS and firewall logs not collected (gap 7)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (monitor critical networks)
treatment_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor with alerts to the IT Manager and Controls Engineer; firewall and DCS logs to the log workspace; weekly review

threat_event: Hydrogen peroxide is diverted through a fraudulent order or altered ERP inventory records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ERP inventory adjustments need no second approval; order screening is informal
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(6) theft and diversion; 27.230(a)(8) critical business systems)
existing_controls: Customer account vetting for new accounts; daily tank level reconciliation
treatment_plan: Two-person approval for inventory adjustments of hydrogen peroxide; monthly review of peroxide orders to new ship-to addresses

threat_event: A former employee uses a still-active DCS account or loading rack driver card
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DCS local accounts and rack cards not in termination or access reviews; 2 accounts and 1 card active (gap 12)
existing_controls: Identity provider accounts disabled the same day
treatment_plan: Add DCS, SIS, and rack cards to the termination checklist; quarterly access review by the Controls Engineer

threat_event: Compromise of the ERP SaaS vendor exposes customer, order, and formulation bill-of-materials data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor SOC 2 never reviewed; complementary user entity controls not mapped (gap 14)
existing_controls: Vendor contract with confidentiality terms; MFA on ERP
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review (P09 Part B); map complementary user entity controls; incident notice clause

threat_event: Legacy CVI, the old Site Security Plan, or formulation files are copied from the broadly shared folder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Folder open to 40 users; no classification policy (gap 13)
treatment_plan: Classify per POL-04; restrict folder to 6 named users; move CVI to a restricted library with access logging

threat_event: Staff paste formulations or process data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; no AI policy (gap 14)
treatment_plan: POL-05 4.8 approved-tools rule; enterprise assistant under evaluation (AI-002)

threat_event: Cloud tenant misconfiguration exposes LIMS or formulation data to the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration baseline for the tenant; no posture scanning
existing_controls: MFA on the cloud console; 2 named administrators
treatment_plan: Cloud security posture checks weekly; baseline in P04

threat_event: Cloud backup vault deleted by an attacker who gains cloud administrator rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups copied to a second region but in the same account with the same administrators
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; break-glass administrator

threat_event: AI-001 recommends an unsafe setpoint that an operator accepts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started without a risk assessment or acceptance criteria (gap 14)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); 40 CFR 68.48(a)(3) safe limits
existing_controls: Operator must accept each recommendation; DCS hard limits; SIS
treatment_plan: Recommendations bounded by the documented safe operating limits; no recommendations for ammonia addition rates; monthly performance review (P10)

threat_event: Historian replica data used by AI-001 is tampered with in the cloud tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Replica writable by the analytics service account
treatment_plan: One-way replication; read-only service account; integrity checks on training data

threat_event: Hurricane causes days of power and communications loss; the plant restarts OT without checking for tampering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office has no generator; no restart checklist for OT
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); 40 CFR 68.50(a)(5) natural hazards
existing_controls: UPS on DCS and SIS; hurricane shutdown procedure
treatment_plan: Add a cyber integrity check (configuration compare, log review) to the post-storm restart procedure

threat_event: Loss of the internet connection isolates the cloud LIMS and the SaaS ERP
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider
treatment_plan: Second internet provider with cellular backup

threat_event: An IT/OT firewall change error blocks DCS communications or opens an unintended path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firewall changes outside MOC; no rule review
treatment_plan: Firewall changes through MOC with Controls Engineer approval; semiannual rule review

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a customer payment or supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No payment-change callback procedure
treatment_plan: Callback verification for any bank detail change; training for finance staff

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts office endpoints and file shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: File shares writable by all office users; backups in the same account
existing_controls: EDR; daily backups with second-region copy
treatment_plan: Least-privilege share permissions; immutable backups (with R-017)

threat_event: Cameras or badge system are disabled over the business network to support theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Video recorder and badge server on the flat business network
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8) other sensitive computerized systems; 27.230(a)(10) monitoring)
treatment_plan: Separate security network segment; alert on camera loss

threat_event: A rogue wireless access point near the tank farm bridges into the control network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No wireless survey of the plant
treatment_plan: Annual wireless survey during the P07 cycle; accept residual risk

threat_event: A cyber-caused release is reported late to the National Response Center, LEPC, and SERC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IR plan is IT-only; notification relies on VoIP phones on the business network (gap 9)
existing_controls: Emergency action plan with a call list
treatment_plan: OT incident runbook (P08); cellular phones and printed call lists in the control room and gatehouse; include a cyber case in the 2026 notification exercise

threat_event: Loading rack automation is manipulated to overfill or misload a customer tanker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rack PLC keeps a default password; on the business network
existing_controls: Ground verification and overfill probe interlock (hardwired)
treatment_plan: Change default password; move the rack PLC behind the OT firewall

threat_event: A compromised DCS vendor update or integrator tool installs malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No integrity check of vendor media; no supplier security clauses (gap 14)
treatment_plan: Verify vendor hashes or signatures; security clauses in the integrator agreement; scan media at the station

threat_event: Operators treat cyber-caused anomalies as instrument faults and keep running
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT cybersecurity training (gap 11)
treatment_plan: Role-based OT training for operators and I&E technicians, including "when to suspect cyber"

threat_event: Employee PII is exposed through the HR SaaS or a phishing attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR vendor security not reviewed
treatment_plan: Review the HR vendor SOC 2 report; limit HR admin roles

threat_event: The DCS release reaches end of vendor support before the upgrade is funded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two releases behind; upgrade not in the 2026 capital plan
treatment_plan: DCS upgrade capital project in the 2027 plan ($240,000), timed with the 2027 turnaround

threat_event: The only Controls Engineer leaves, and nobody else can restore or change the DCS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single point of knowledge; no documented procedures
treatment_plan: Documented restore and change procedures; cross-train one I&E technician; integrator retainer with response times
